prompts.name: 01-slime-mind
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished logo exploration sheet for Raphael, a second brain for agents that organizes ideas into actionable knowledge. Blend the feel of a thoughtful anime inner intelligence inspired by the Wisdom King / Great Sage idea in That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, with Raphael's restrained Material 3 Expressive identity. This is an original app identity. Palette: canvas #f8f6fc, lilac #a18ade and #e9e1f5, violet #5b3fc8, deep purple ink #24134f; optional tiny peach #ffd0b8 accent. Rounded geometry, balanced negative space, crisp flat vector-like rendering, strong scalable silhouette. No photorealism, 3D, neon, glow, stock brain clipart, generic AI sparkle, circuit-board clutter, anime character portrait, or merchandise mockup. Layout: generous breathing room on a square pale canvas, one dominant standalone symbol in upper half, symbol plus lowercase wordmark below, then two small examples at bottom: monochrome symbol and rounded-square app icon. Same exact symbol in every example. Wordmark text verbatim "raphael", lowercase Sora-like geometric sans with a double-storey a, deep purple ink. A tiny simple direction title at top as specified. No other text. The main symbol should occupy about 40% of sheet width.
Direction title verbatim: "01 / slime mind".
Primary symbol: A compact gently domed slime silhouette becomes an abstract brain: two smooth interlocking hemispheres with only two bold curved interior folds, subtle thoughtful anime-eye negative spaces integrated into folds rather than pasted-on face. One soft wave at base. Friendly and clever, not anatomical. Use lilac body and violet folds; clean thick shapes. The dome is slightly wider than tall.
